existing_upstream_findings.finding: Validate the signed cached MSI database identity
existing_upstream_findings.reason_not_reproposed: The exact current-head defect is already posted upstream. The fork validates the staged MSI ProductCode and expected UpgradeCode, but the test-only convergence commit is not a new upstream finding.

existing_upstream_findings.finding: Bind bundle validation to the bytes executed
existing_upstream_findings.reason_not_reproposed: The exact current-head check-then-execute defect is already posted upstream. The fork now uses protected staging and revalidates both signature and PowerToys Burn identity on the protected copy.

existing_upstream_findings.finding: Allow current-user cleanup before machine-wide elevation
existing_upstream_findings.reason_not_reproposed: The exact current-head standard-user recovery failure is already posted upstream. The fork separates the non-elevated per-user pass from elevated machine-wide work.

fork_changes_this_run.subject: Add cleanup destructive-path tests
fork_changes_this_run.details: Adds five focused Pester scenarios, makes the orchestration dot-sourceable for isolated tests, extracts uninstall exit-code accounting, and revalidates the protected bundle copy's PowerToys Burn identity before execution.

fork_changes_this_run.subject: Handle cleanup validation failures
fork_changes_this_run.details: Restores process-level environment variables after tests, proves aggregation with a validation exception plus a later uninstall failure, and catches MSI validation exceptions per product so cleanup continues.

fork_changes_this_run.subject: Correct mixed-scope cleanup order
fork_changes_this_run.details: Documents machine-wide cleanup before per-user cleanup, defers per-user bundles while a machine-wide target remains, and adds a no-launch focused test. This corrects behavior introduced by the fork's non-elevated recovery flow and is not a new upstream defect.

fork_changes_this_run.subject: Harden cleanup path handling
fork_changes_this_run.details: Removes filesystem trees without descending through reparse points, resolves msiexec.exe from Environment.SystemDirectory, and aggregates exceptions from the second LocalPackage lookup. All changes address fork-only review defects and are not proposed upstream.

fork_changes_this_run.subject: Separate privileged and profile cleanup
fork_changes_this_run.details: Eliminates elevated recursive deletion of profile-owned paths, defers -RemoveSettings to the non-elevated affected-profile pass, removes HKCU\Software\Microsoft\PowerToys there, and documents the boundary. This avoids an unsafe, unverified handle-relative deletion redesign.

exact_candidate_controlled_test.limitations: This controlled proof validates PowerShell control flow and failure preservation on the literal candidate. It does not call Windows Installer, validate a real MSI signature, launch msiexec, alter the registry, remove files, elevate, or reproduce a real damaged Windows Installer registration.
